inputs.text: President John Mahama is standing strong for our nation's sovereignty by refusing to bend our core policies to foreign pressure. He's making clear that everything must stay rooted in our established laws, time-honored cultural traditions, and the shared values of our own people rather than outside agendas. Amid these so-called global human rights talks, which are really just progressive tools meant to weaken national authority, traditional order, and the family, he's renewing his pledge to the rule of law. As he put it, “I took an oath to uphold [...]” This kind of firm resistance to imported ideas is what will protect our way of life and keep society stable.

output.main_topic: President John Mahama's resistance to foreign pressure in defense of national sovereignty and established values
